bounded_bridge_property.description: Induced return blocks admit a bounded-bridge / concatenation compatibility proxy strong enough to support a pressure argument.

bounded_return_times.description: Observed first-return lengths stay in a finite controlled window instead of immediately requiring an unbounded tail statement.

core_return_coverage.description: The chosen delayed-return core captures a nontrivial share of the induced mass and is not a vacuous witness.

delayed_return_core_exists.description: An explicit delayed-return core interval can be identified and return blocks can be defined relative to it.

feedback_free_admissibility.description: Admissibility is stationary and not changed by runtime feedback.

full_core_induction.description: Every surviving original cylinder/set is represented by the delayed-return core up to a uniformly bounded entry/exit correction, so the induced tower captures the full attractor modulo bounded distortion constants.

induced_alphabet_control.description: Induced alphabet growth is controlled well enough to keep the induced coding theorem-amenable on the intended class.

local_domain_compatibility.description: Gate, hold, and return words respect the local domains strongly enough to define an induced coding on the chosen core.

nontrivial_induced_structure.description: The induced coding does not collapse to a size-1 trivial finite-state core.

stationary_local_admissibility.description: Map domains and admissibility law are fixed in time.

strict_return_contraction.description: Each return block has contraction weight strictly less than 1, so induced weights decay with s and the induced pressure has a genuine root at finite s.

uniform_entry_exit_bound.description: The prefix/suffix correction needed to pass between original cylinders and induced return-block cylinders is uniformly bounded over the class.

usable_overlap_control.description: Overlap/packaging behavior is controlled well enough that the induced return coding is geometrically meaningful.
